body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature within 3 units fails an Action or has an Action fail against you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Make the triggering creature Exposed. If it was already Exposed, it instead burns 1 die.

surges.html: After the triggering effect resolves, move its source or one of its eligible destinations 1 unit if the effect permits movement.
If this Reaction affects an enemy, it cannot make another Reaction until the start of its next turn.
